item: OverlayHost click-through window styles (WS_EX_TRANSPARENT | WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_NOREDIRECTIONBITMAP | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_TOPMOST)
notes: OverlayHost.CreateOverlayWindow sets WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TRANSPARENT | WS_EX_TOPMOST | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_NOACTIVATE | WS_EX_NOREDIRECTIONBITMAP (0x082800A8) and WindowProcedure returns HTTRANSPARENT (-1) on WM_NCHITTEST (132u).

AUD-H-003: CaptureExclusion applies SetWindowDisplayAffinity(hwnd, 0x11) and ScreenCaptureYield uses DwmSetWindowAttribute(DWMWA_CLOAK = 13) + SetWindowPos during snipping tools, but OverlayHost.ThreadMain finally block never calls ScreenCaptureYield.Unregister(WindowHandle).

item: Multi-monitor virtual screen bounds (SM_XVIRTUALSCREEN..SM_CYVIRTUALSCREEN) and WM_DPICHANGED handling
notes: AUD-H-004: Virtual screen bounds use GetSystemMetrics(76..79) and refresh on WM_DISPLAYCHANGE (126u), but WM_DPICHANGED (736u) returns LRESULT(0) without calling RefreshDisplays().

item: OverlayHost GPU device loss recovery (DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED / DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_RESET)
notes: AUD-H-002: RunLoop has no catch/recreate path for DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED (0x887A0005); any device loss kills the overlay thread permanently while leaving OverlayHost.shared non-null.

item: CursorOverlay, CursorLayer, FramePacer, idle CPU/GPU usage, and PenRideTrajectory physics
notes: AUD-H-003: Idle CPU/GPU blocks indefinitely on WaitHandle.WaitAny when shouldTick is false, and PenRideTrajectory physics passed deterministic trajectory tests (WsHiAuditRunner Test 3), but FramePacer leaks its kernel waitable timer handle (CreateWaitableTimerExW) without CloseHandle/IDisposable.

AUD-H-005: GraphicsCaptureSource leaks Direct3D11CaptureFrame when TrySetResult loses a race; ScreenCaptureService hardcodes gpus[0] for WGC fallback on multi-GPU systems; DesktopDuplicationSource ignores ProtectedContentMaskedOut.

item: LowLevelInputHub WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook timeout, thread priority, keystroke logging, AltGr, and cleanup
notes: AUD-H-006: Uses ThreadPriority.Highest and does not log alphanumeric keystrokes to disk, and AltGr (LCtrl+RAlt) is filtered in ShortcutMonitor, but Release() never stops the hook thread or unhooks WH_KEYBOARD_LL, and CheckHookAlive replays duplicate keys under UIPI or >80ms hook latency.

item: ShortcutMonitor hotkey state machine, AltGr filtering, and Start Menu masking
notes: AUD-H-007: MaskStartMenu() is only invoked for ShortcutAction.DictationDown when Dictation has HotkeyModifiers.Win, omitting PushToTalk, TextMode, and HandsFreeDictation.

item: ClickyScreenActuator, ClickyTakeBackWatch, ClickyUserInputBlocker, and ClickyTakeOverController safety
notes: AUD-H-010 & AUD-H-006: ClickyTakeOverController sets actuatingUntil = Now + 30s and ignores ClickyTakeBackWatch mouse take-back callbacks during active actuation; EnsureConsentToDriveAsync skips user consent for 600s (recent_yes) or after any PTT press during an offer card; ClickyUserInputBlocker re-hooks WH_MOUSE_LL/WH_KEYBOARD_LL every 1s.

item: WASAPI Audio (WasapiMicrophoneCapture, WasapiAudioOutput, VoiceRenderStream, WasapiRenderStream, EarconPlayer, AudioTopologyMonitor) and PermissionService
notes: AUD-H-009: Hot-swap via AudioTopologyMonitor, Bluetooth Hands-Free avoidance, linear resampling, and underrun recovery work properly, but EarconPlayer.DecodeWavToStereo48k throws DivideByZeroException on <8-bit WAV headers and PermissionService.ReadConsentStoreValue leaks an HKEY handle.

item: UIAutomationHelpers, UiaPageText, ForegroundAppInfo, DictationTextTarget, and TextInsertion
notes: AUD-H-001 & AUD-H-008: UiaPageText and ReadBrowserAddress scrape Incognito/InPrivate browsers, password managers, and password fields (ignoring UIA_IsPasswordPropertyId) and send them to /brain/turn; DictationTextTarget.BlindPasteAsync and TextInsertion.SnapshotClipboard destroy user clipboard contents.

item: BrainSession screenshot pruning (MaximumScreenshotsInThread = 48), BrainSseParser SSE streaming, and CompanionSession state transitions
notes: AUD-I-001: BrainSession screenshot pruning (48 cap) and BrainSseParser SSE chunk/CR/LF parsing passed all dynamic tests (WsHiAuditRunner Tests 2 & 4), and CompanionSession properly handles PTT interruptions and state transitions, but CompanionSession executes LLM typeText via WindowsDesktopActions.TypeIntoFocusedFieldAsync without user confirmation or password/terminal guards.

item: SayLines JS parser and DrawingCaptionTiming audio/caption synchronization
notes: AUD-I-002: DrawingCaptionTiming passed all synchronization and latency tests (WsHiAuditRunner Test 2), but SayLines.Extract extracts false-positive say(...) calls from JS comments and strings, misses say (...) with whitespace, and corrupts \r and \uXXXX escapes (WsHiAuditRunner Test 1).

item: ClickyInkParser, ClickyInkPatchStream, ClickyInkMatch, ClickyInkNoteStore, ClickyLiveNoteStore, ClickyInkDashboardSplit, ClickyInkFrontPagePlanner
notes: AUD-I-003 & AUD-I-004: ClickyInkParser withstood malformed markdown, unclosed <ink-...> tags, 120-deep nesting, and 5,000-line inputs in 15ms without hanging, but EmphasisMarks/MarkingFirstLink corrupts every **bold**, ==highlight==, and [link](url) span into literal integer digits ('57345$157346'), and ClickyInkNoteStore/ClickyLiveNoteStore suffer from unsynchronized Dictionary mutations across threads.

category: WS-I: Core & Platform Thread-Safety & Unhandled Exceptions
item: Scan Kursor.Core (565 files) and Kursor.Platform (346 files) for async void, unawaited tasks, lock ordering, and UnobservedTaskException
notes: AUD-I-005: 0 async void methods exist and CrashReporting.cs:203 registers TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException, but 53 unawaited Task.Run/ContinueWith sites lack local fault observation and 4 iterator methods contain ILSpy Iterator.Dispose() decompilation failures.
